title: Prairie Fox — Implementation Docket (personal)
content:
Context / quick summary:
Prairie Fox is a mid-market client (fintech) needing a Private deployment inside their AWS account (VPC) for regulatory reasons. They will start with 2 dedicated TPU/GPU nodes (p3x2-like equivalent) and want model pinning + canary rollouts. Latency SLO: 95th <= 180ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens); cost target: <$0.0006/token average after batching.

Recent meeting notes (2026-03-10):
- PF security: must use customer KMS for model keys + HSM for signing. Legal wants audit log retention 2y.
- Networking: no public egress for inference hosts; control plane needs peered VPC endpoints.
- Ops: prefer canary by traffic-split, not by region.
- Data: they will send PII in prompts; need encryption at rest and in transit.

Immediate action list (prio order):
[ ] Create infra ticket for VPC endpoints and SG rules (owner: Lucas) — due 2026-03-13
[ ] Draft KMS/HSM integration plan (owner: Priya) — due 2026-03-15
[ ] Define model pinning policy template + example rollout YAML — due 2026-03-12
[ ] Set up telemetry dashboard template in Console (owner: Maya) — due 2026-03-18
[ ] Prepare short perf-run prompts for baseline (10 prompts, 3 lengths) — due 2026-03-14

Config notes / example snippets (working):
# rollout policy (pseudo-yaml)
model_rollout:
  - version: pf-model-v1-quant
    traffic: 90
  - version: pf-model-v1-quant-safe
    traffic: 10
failure_policy: fallback-to: pf-model-v1-fp16
metrics: [latency.p95, error_rate, coherence.score]

Serving/runtime hints:
- Start with continuous batching enabled, max_batch_size=32, max_latency_ms=40.
- Enable prefix KV cache for common customer system prompts (they have a 40% prefix reuse).
- Quantized model (4-bit) OK if coherence >= .92 on eval set; otherwise use fp16.
- Keep token limit at 2048 for first phase.

Telemetry + alerts (what PF cares about):
- Alert if p95 latency > 200ms for 5m window.
- Alert if error_rate > 0.5% for 10m.
- Daily sync: cost-per-1k-tokens and gross spend burn-rate.

Risks / open questions:
- HSM integration path: API vs appliance? (Need contact in infra/security team at PF)
- Canary rollback SLA: how quickly do they want failover? (immediate vs 10m threshold)
- Data residency: logs stored in customer S3 vs Redwood-managed archive? (legal decision)

Decisions to record (for handoff):
- Use customer KMS for keys: YES (agreed 2026-03-10)
- Start with quantized model but allow fp16 fallback: PROVISIONAL
- Autoscaling policy: reserved min=2 nodes, max=6 nodes, burst allowed via Dedicated burst pool

Prompt eval checklist (prep):
- 10 short prompts (<64 tokens), 10 mid (128-256), 5 long (~800)
- Eval script: compute coherence (embedding cosine vs ref), token usage, latency per token, p95
- Run at T=off-peak and T=peak (simulate concurrency 20 TPS)

Handy links / refs to stash for final plan:
- Confluence draft: confluence:PrairieFox-Integration-Plan
- Jira epic: JIRA-PRX-4123

Notes to self: keep personal log entries short. When writing final handoff doc, include exact CLI commands for k8s/node labels + sample policy JSON for KMS bindings. Also collect a contact list from PF security (name + email) before next sync.

Quick timeline (rough):
- Week 1: infra & security (VPC endpoints, KMS scope)
- Week 2: model onboarding, baseline perf tests
- Week 3: canary rollout + telemetry validation
- Week 4: production cutover & runbook handoff

Recent quick commands I ran locally (put here so I don't forget):
- rwdctl deploy --env pf-staging --model pf-model-v1-quant --nodes 2
- rwdctl perf --concurrency 20 --prompt-file perf-prompts.txt --out perf-20260310.json

Small reminders:
- Ask legal for exact retention wording for audit logs ("2 years" vs "24 months")
- Confirm if PF requires IP allowlist on control-plane egress

End of docket — update before next sync on 2026-03-12.
